_README: D64 plan P12: the confirmatory replication of the two borderline image contrasts on passes 4-6, with the secondary analyses (report only; plan reports/s164-agent-records/d64-a06-replication.md P12 and P12.1, commits e783ed3ac, 751525d7e, 2d5cb991c).

settings.criterion_b: BH-adjusted p < 0.05 across C1 and C2 only
